comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Created via Transmutation Alchemy, R13 Casting/Alchemy, using Terra Amina as a base ingredient. Essentially the same as a normal Terra Amina, but with the following EX Effect:

R12 Increase Relic Clue acquisition

The Apotolos Amina is the only piece of equipment in the game that gives such a high Relic Clue acquisition boost. Cheers.

Source: maitanblog2014.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-225.html (stats/pics), gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Product/Alchemy/ItemBoost (EX effect EQ table)

wiki: Possible to upgrade into Apotolos Amina EX using Transmutation Alchemy; see page for details.
